sourcePolicy: Publish only current AVC vacancies whose public details have been verified from the concerned recruitment source. Do not invent employers, salaries, vacancy counts, deadlines, benefits, licences or selection claims.

lifecycle.expiryRule: Open and closing-soon jobs require validThrough. The website automatically hides a job after validThrough.
lifecycle.freshnessRule: Every public job must carry lastVerifiedAt and should be rechecked before continued publication.
lifecycle.schemaRule: JobPosting structured data is generated only when the actual hiring organization and required location/date facts are available. AVC is not substituted as the employer.
